verdict.rationale: Headless automation is a fair question for a government e-services agency. CRA's only documented non-interactive channel is EFILE, where certified tax software transmits returns system-to-system. That channel is gated behind software certification and electronic-filer enrollment, and it covers only return filing, not general scriptable use of CRA services in CI. Missing for 10: a documented public API or CLI for scripted or CI use, automation of other services (registration, payments, documents) without the web portal, any authentication model for unattended or CI runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: certified software plus an enrolled electronic filer transmit returns system-to-system
